blindReviewDeclaration: Fresh independent DESIGN review formed counterexamples from current design, ledger, bindings, fixture catalog and checker before author disposition; no runtime was started.
expectedBehavior: All 196 canonical operations have exact source-reading evidence or an explicit source gap.
A declared FQCN never substitutes for a physical adapter path and method.
The 196-operation fixture denominator is static-green before Testcontainers plan/report extension.
One complete implementation package preserves owner correctness and delays Testcontainers until static closure.

findings.title: 45条命令将声明FQCN冒充实际adapter源码锚点
findings.evidence: 196行ledger exact-set/unique虽通过，但45个非M1 COMMAND的 actualSourceAnchors.adapter 是如 com.catering...AcceptPublicInvitationOperation 的FQCN，仓内不存在对应物理 Java path#execute，行内也没有GAP_ADAPTER_SOURCE_ANCHOR。
findings.risk: 实施者可能把类型名称误当已重开adapter调用链，使inventory/one-origin约束可在未读实际源码时漂移。
findings.disposition: 补45条明确GAP_ADAPTER_SOURCE_ANCHOR及声明类型；只以当前物理edge-to-owner证据入账，未来inventory不得由FQCN造路径；BPF-U02仅在真实源码产生后替换该gap。

findings.title: 现有196-operation fixture静态门失败但U06未收编其surface
findings.evidence: 只读 scripts/check/backend-performance-final-fixture-catalog --check 输出 BP_FINAL_FIXTURE_PLAN_OWNER_HTTP_OPENAPI_DRIFT；原BPF-U06只列seed report、remote Testcontainers runner与comparator，漏掉 fixture catalog及checker。
findings.risk: 未静态闭合owner HTTP/OpenAPI/fixture读回分母就无法诚实生成196/196 grouped Testcontainers plan/report，且会诱发未授权临场修补。
findings.disposition: U06纳入 fixture catalog、checker、materializer；先修owner HTTP/OpenAPI exact drift和red mutation，再扩展grouped plan/report。

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The independent inventory, shape declaration, owner correctness preservation and Testcontainers/seed/L2 separation fit the approved problem, but the two concrete evidence/control gaps prevent admission.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: A physical-anchor gap and an existing fixture-control repair are smaller and safer than a new dispatcher, cache, broad source allowlist or dynamic workaround.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: The fixes are row/control-plane corrections within the one delivery, avoiding later dynamic rework.
solutionReasonableness.verdict: NO_GO until both findings are resolved.

conclusion.summary: The 196 denominator and permanent architecture are sound, but 45 declared adapter types lack physical evidence and the required Testcontainers fixture predecessor is currently red and omitted from U06.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: This verdict is static DESIGN evidence only; it grants no implementation, dynamic, DEV, Testcontainers, reset/seed, L2, UAT, deployment or performance-success claim.
